poses: Holding a small snack with both hands at chest, eyes on it
Snack rising to mouth, mouth opening slightly
Taking a small bite, eyes closed happily, cheeks puffed slightly
Chewing gently with satisfied expression, snack lowered a bit
Swallowing, tiny happy sparkle in eyes
Raising snack for another bite, anticipating
Second small bite, blushing with delight
Snack lowered, full satisfied smile, back to holding pose
